Paul — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the pilot momentum.

High-level options that usually work for this pattern (short answer first):
1) Surge pack (recommended short-term): one-off token bucket that attaches to your account immediately. We can size a 30-day pack with an MRC credit applied to renewal if you choose to annualize. Typical lead time: minutes after payment.
2) Staged top-up (monthly true-up): incremental monthly capacity billed monthly. Lower up-front credit but flexible.
3) Mid-contract amendment (co-term uplift): increases committed units for the remainder of the term with a one-time pro-rata and potential discount in exchange for commitment. Better unit economics long term.

I've attached a quick pricing worksheet with a sample 30-day surge pack and a 3-month staged top-up scenario. If you want the better long-term economics we can draft a short amendment and include a limited-time uplift discount (we're able to provide a promotional uplift discount if GreenBridge annualizes within 90 days).

Next steps I suggest:
- You pick 1–2 options you prefer (surge pack or staged top-up) — I can get procurement-ready numbers.
- If you want the amendment path, we'll need internal approvals (Ben on pricing, Kimberly on legal).

Attachments: RB-pricing-worksheet-20261004.xlsx, dft_amendment_greenbridge_v1.pdf

I can be on a 30-min call today at 2:00pm PT if that works.

Best,
Soojin Lee
